subject: VAT auto-flagging + cross-border liability handoff for GreenGrid — action and docs
messages:
From: Olivia Price <ops@greengrid.co.uk>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Alex Marino <ap@greengrid.co.uk>
Date: 2026-09-09T08:12:00Z
Subject: VAT treatment for Sep invoice — VAT ID mismatch and split request

Hi Sean,

We're ready to pay the September invoice but our finance team reports the invoice was auto-tagged as UK VAT when it should be treated under reverse-charge (GreenGrid is an Irish B2B buyer). Your system flagged our VAT ID as invalid during checkout (we used IE1234567V).

Can you:
- Confirm whether you can reissue a split invoice showing 0% VAT + reverse-charge note, or provide guidance for us to self-attest?
- Let us know if you can temporarily hold payment capture until this is resolved (we prefer to avoid duplicate tax filings).

I've attached our VAT registration PDF (greengrid_vat_cert.png). If you need anything else, loop in your tax/accounting team.

Thanks,
Olivia
Operations Manager
GreenGrid Ltd

Attachment: greengrid_vat_cert.png (image/png)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Price <ops@greengrid.co.uk>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>, Alex Marino <ap@greengrid.co.uk>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for Sep invoice — VAT ID mismatch and split request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads-up and the attachment. Quick summary / next steps from our side: 

1) VAT ID validation: our checkout uses a nightly VIES check and a secondary OCR-based validation. That snapshot flagged the IE number as non-matching to the company name (common with older IE formats). Neha — can you run a manual VIES + tax-team review?

2) Split invoice option: we can issue a "split liability" invoice (one line for net charge, a second line noting "VAT reverse-charge — recipient liable" and zero VAT amount). Marissa, accounting: can we prepare a provisional split invoice and mark it as a reissue so we don't double-bill?

3) Payment hold: We can place a 72-hour payment-hold on the hosted charge so capture is deferred. That gives time for docs and manual verification without forcing GreenGrid to refund. Irene — I'll need the standard payment-hold instruction doc (we have a template).

Olivia, if you can also send a short self-attestation (one paragraph stating that GreenGrid is a registered EU VAT-registered business purchasing for business use) that would speed things up. If the tax team confirms the VAT ID, we'll reissue and capture.

I'll keep this convo as the single source of truth.

Best,
Sean
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olivia Price <ops@greengrid.co.uk>, Alex Marino <ap@greengrid.co.uk>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for Sep invoice — VAT ID mismatch and split request

Thanks Sean — accounting notes below: 

- We can generate a provisional reissued invoice with split liability. We'll include: original invoice number reference, net amount lines, and a comment field with the reverse-charge legal note.
- Important: the reissue will be marked "Provisional — do not file until tax verification confirmed." That prevents the buyer from prematurely filing VAT reports.
- Once Neha confirms the VAT ID via VIES, we finalize and capture. If VIES fails but GreenGrid provides alternate evidence (certificate + self-attestation), we can proceed with manual override but must attach evidence in the invoice PDF (audit trail).

I've attached a draft (invoice_split_proposal.pdf) showing how we'd present the lines. Please review and mark comments.

Marissa
Senior Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_split_proposal.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alex Marino <ap@greengrid.co.uk>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olivia Price <ops@greengrid.co.uk>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for Sep invoice — VAT ID mismatch and split request

Hey Marissa / Sean,

Thanks — attached is a short self-attestation from our CFO confirming business use and the VAT registration (see greengrid_vat_cert.png again). We hit an internal audit note saying our previous Irish VAT format was still valid — maybe VIES is lagging. 

We'd be happy with the provisional reissue + 72h hold so our AP team can confirm internally. If you'd rather have us sign a short attestation template, send it over and we'll return it today.

Best,
Alex
Accounts Payable
GreenGrid

Attachment: greengrid_vat_cert.png (image/png)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olivia Price <ops@greengrid.co.uk>, Alex Marino <ap@greengrid.co.uk>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for Sep invoice — VAT ID mismatch and split request

Checked VIES (manual) at 2026-09-10T08:45Z — the IE number returns valid and matches company name partial match but with an outdated company suffix in registry. Action plan: 

- I'll mark the ID valid in our tax-tool (manual override) and attach the VIES screenshot to the invoice.
- Accounting: please include the VIES verification screenshot and the greengrid_vat_cert.png in the finalized PDF.
- Payments: Sean — place the 72h hold on capture; if the capture window expires before we finalize, we'll extend by agreement with GreenGrid.

I'll also create a short internal note for audit "Manual VIES override due to registry suffix mismatch".

Neha
Tax Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vies_screenshot_20260910.png (image/png)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Price <ops@greengrid.co.uk>, Alex Marino <ap@greengrid.co.uk>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T16:47:00Z
Subject: Final: reissue instructions + capture schedule (GreenGrid)

Hi Olivia / Alex — wrapping up: 

1) We've placed a 72-hour payment hold on the outstanding hosted capture (will expire 2026-09-14T16:47:00Z unless extended).
2) Accounting will issue a provisional reissued invoice (ref: INV-20260909-GG-provisional) showing split liability and the reverse-charge note. It will contain: greengrid_vat_cert.png + vies_screenshot_20260910.png embedded.
3) Once finalized, we'll notify you and proceed to capture. If you need the attestation in a signed DocuSign, here's the link — please sign and we'll finalize earlier: https://docusign.com/rs/greengrid-attest/ABC123

Marissa — finalise the PDF and move to finalized status after attaching the evidence. Neha — please add your internal note to the invoice audit trail. Irene — payment-hold doc is in the drive (payment_hold_instructions.docx) — please attach to the ticket.

Olivia/Alex, thanks for the quick turnaround. If all good, expect reissued PDF within 4 business hours.

Best,
Sean
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
